Gadget Review separates a criminal export-control case from civil allegations and a short-seller report that proposes a connection involving a former executive. It also includes a company denial of the alleged role and says the photo-based identity link is unverified.

The article’s headline must not turn that uncertain identity claim into fact. Charges against other named defendants are not convictions, and the examined reporting does not establish criminal conduct by the people implicated only through the contested connection.
highlights: Report distinguishes criminal and civil proceedings
Short seller has a financial interest
No guilt follows from association or a headline
